{{Top|leg}}
'''Hanpat''' was a dangerous chemical created by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[the Colony]] which was placed inside and flung upon enemy positions. [[Burnball]]s, as the spheres were called, ruptured upon impact. The rupture caused the chemical to cover a large area. When hanpat came into contact with the air, it ignited.
